name: Enhanced movement (Going Commando)
author: kmomoney
description: Ratchet moves like he does in Going Commando. His speed follows the stick, he starts and stops quicker, and he doesn't skid when you let go. You also get more control in the air, a strafe on L2 or R2 with side and back flips, the wrench timing from Going Commando, a faster camera and better controls for Clank. Jump heights and damage stay the same, so every level plays as designed.

settings.name: Going Commando running
settings.description: Speed follows how far you push the stick. Ratchet starts, stops and turns as in Going Commando, and doesn't skid when you let go.

settings.name: Going Commando air control
settings.description: More control in the air, most of all in the double jump. Jump heights stay the same.

settings.name: Strafe button
settings.description: Hold it to strafe: Ratchet faces where the camera looks and moves without turning. L1 still looks, R1 still crouches, and if you pick one button the other works as usual.

settings.name: Strafe flips
settings.description: While strafing, X with the stick pushed fully left, right or back flips that way.

settings.name: Hip twist
settings.description: While strafing, Ratchet's hips turn toward where he's going and his upper body keeps facing ahead.

settings.name: Going Commando wrench
settings.description: The wrench timing from Going Commando: a Square pressed early still counts, and you can run or jump out of swings and throws sooner. Damage stays the same.

settings.name: Camera turn speed
settings.description: How fast the right stick turns the camera. Going Commando always turns it at that game's top speed, faster than any original setting.

settings.name: Clank
settings.description: How Clank handles on his own. Going Commando makes him quicker to start, stop, turn and recover from a punch, and Enhanced also makes him a bit faster with more air control.

settings.name: Trace
settings.description: For bug reports: writes what the mod does to the game's log, every frame.
